claim: one unseen actuator-response body, permitted fresh calibration, frozen-fit homing on the known route; no zero-shot, population, compensation-benefit, physical or full-M6 qualification

entrypoint_contract.old_body_profile_attribute: must remain absent; never remove one to bypass validation

world.authoring: memory_world.configure(env, memory_world.initial_state(close_subject_id=None)); then declared lane goal/start; never advance memory schedule
world.calibration_reset: three explicit ordinary Engine resets between four trials; seed remains 1; re-author and check the same lane/body after each reset
world.homing_reset: fresh second Engine owner; same authored body/lane; consume only admitted fit artifact, never restore calibration snapshot

native_model_world_authoring: named obstacle x/y joint ranges, preserving prior half-widths, only as pinned memory_world.configure
native_model_body: actuator_gear[left_motor,0]: 3.0 -> 2.1; every other actuator value unchanged
mutation_allowlist.native_data: explicit fresh reset, named obstacle qpos/zero qvel, declared rover pose, zero controls/encoders/time; ordinary simulation during measured intervals
mutation_allowlist.environment_caches: only pinned world authoring and fresh-state pose/planner/exploration caches; observation refreshed after mj_forward before first interval

before_any_action: manual paused, no pending commands, no policy or teacher, no task/body/memory state, no old body profile attribute
model names/dimensions and nominal gear order [left_motor,right_motor] validated
canonical nominal authored model matches the existing baseline model hash before the first gear write
after gear write canonical model differs only at the one declared scalar; same resulting model hash at all five episode initials
time, episode tick, wheel angles, qvel, controls, speed, stall counter and last/manual actions zero
start pose, goal, declared world, radius/track and zero local task odometry checked
actual initial observations and separate raw snapshot retained after callback removal; no time advance
initial_admission.other_initial_equalities: exact for model fields, zero arrays, counters, encoder/time and IDs; track tolerance 1e-12 only as existing physical calibration
initial_admission.snapshots: five raw episode initials only: four calibration trials and one homing initial; generic Engine application state excludes separate study state; no custom-state continuation/replay claim

calibration.fit_method: unchanged zero-intercept per-wheel fit_wheel_gains for each contiguous 100-sample trial and all 400; unchanged agreement and compensate_wheels admission
calibration.early_termination: ineligible calibration, no padding/replacement/retry; homing remains not_started
calibration.fit_identity: bind protocol/source/model, all four recording episode/tick ranges, sample ordering/hash, pooled/per-trial fit/hash and producer run; homing read-only, no mutation/refit

homing.stopped_rule: both quantized encoder increments exactly zero; not physical-rest proof
homing.initial_task: task_profiles.initialize encoder-homing at the second owner fresh shaft origin
homing.driver: unchanged cue_action v2; initial requested action zero; subsequent request from previous recorded study cue only
homing.cue_storage: study cue float32 pair promoted to float64 for driver exactly as historical effective-sensor projection
homing.current_tick_task: capture named encoder/time/tick before physics; advance the private study task; current hold overrides requested action to zero before compensation
homing.conversion: effective_control(nominal) float32; compensate_wheels using frozen pooled fit; inverse_control exact float32 target roundtrip; applied action finite float64 through normal manual Engine step; no clipping/fallback/direct ctrl write
homing.completion: after publishing the full interval whose pre-control task reaches phase complete, stop the standalone driver; retain original Engine outcome unchanged
homing.functional_acceptance: study phase complete, outbound reached, five declared dwell increments, true declared-origin XY distance <=0.25m, <=600 executed intervals, no native/contact/control/provenance/infra failure
homing.outcome_separation: Engine upstream goal/stall/collision/time_limit/user_stop outcomes remain original; study.task_completed is separate; an earlier Engine terminal cannot be suppressed or reset to continue
homing.evaluator_access: native poses and declared initial XY are evaluator-only; no feedback into task, driver, fit or compensation

pipeline.contact_scope: unchanged ContactProbe: all timed pairs, reject unexpected robot incident; allowed rover-floor support and world-only contact separately classified
pipeline.contact_timing: ten pre-control caches plus last unchanged cached contact packet; not continuous collision freedom or fresh endpoint contact

recording.numeric: existing Engine rows plus body contact/encoder/control arrays and distinct study cue/task phase/odometry/hold/nominal intent fields; original upstream sensors/actions/outcome fields never relabelled
recording.publication: reuse one-pending-tick instance-local writer deferral from verify_body_gains; publish once only after complete contact/control checks; restore writer method and callback in finally; rejected pending packet retained and not counted as accepted numeric interval
recording.study_state: external audit metadata, not Engine application state; no replay/restore qualification
recording.fit_manifest: one bounded fit artifact produced by calibration and hashed into homing; no historical raw/SNP/checkpoint input
recording.initial_event: original reproduction episode_started remains history; append explicit study world/body authoring event and original/actual model/world hashes before first action
recording.schema_gate: prove added numeric allowance <=32KiB and each existing recorder chunk limit before actual controls; source-only fixture required

rows.requires: calibration accepted, exact fit/source/model readmission, unchanged source/whole-study capacity

disposition.operational_and_functional: separate fields; clean process exit is never task success
disposition.calibration_rejection: calibration failed-functional with raw reason and all executed rows; homing not_started dependency_failed; no second body/fit
disposition.homing_natural_failure: retain complete recording/outcome and failed-functional; no retries or subsequent arms
disposition.protocol_or_infrastructure_failure: stop first failure; preserve logs/raw pending interval/receipts and remaining not_started rows
disposition.positive_gate: both rows completed, calibration accepted, homing functional acceptance, normal timing/storage/source/cleanup all admitted

limits.cleanup_scope: normal acceptance stays 830; termination/failure cleanup may finish later and is never positive evidence or a universal kernel-return guarantee

capacity_and_controls.before_execution: mandatory fresh whole-study check after source freeze/control review: exclusive absent output, all two rows/five snapshots/results/logs/staging included, managed quota admission, disk free >= output_max_bytes + min_free_bytes; no stale review-time df substituted
capacity_and_controls.repeat: before every owner/reset boundary and final publication; sampled output/inventory and writer checks are not atomic whole-filesystem reservation
capacity_and_controls.lease: one existing inner writer lease only; no outer lease
capacity_and_controls.identity: full frozen tracked producer/upstream/runtime/asset and control inventories before/after; exact Python3.11.15 and NumPy2.2.5/MuJoCo3.3.6; no source changes while actual jobs run
capacity_and_controls.supervision: reuse reviewed finite first-ready sampler, exact PID/start conflict rejection, scoped interruption, bounded_process TERM/KILL/drain and identity-rechecked cleanup; any sampler error/forced cleanup/survivor/late acceptance fails
capacity_and_controls.actual_controls: not created or authorized by this protocol; separate source and controls reviews plus exclusive runtime GO required

required_pure_checks: fixed configuration/types/body/world mutation allowlist and initial-state failures
four complete probes, exact sample ordering and rejection with homing not_started
private encoder cue versus poisoned raw upstream truth; hold before compensation
bounded pending numeric interval and callback/writer restoration on failure
separate Engine and study outcomes; raw initials do not contain a restorable custom task
whole-study byte/time admission and first-failure reducer
implementation_scope.review_stop: if a shared source change, new dispatch, guard bypass, source-state relabelling or greater allowance becomes necessary, stop for root review; no generic factory/registry
